correctness.rationale: For t_i equal to the parity of the binary digit sum and P_n=t_0...t_{n-1}, fairness is exactly D=number(01 scattered)-number(10 scattered)=0. Reconstruct D(uv)=D(u)+D(v)+(h(u)|v|-|u|h(v))/2, h=#0-#1. Both four-letter substitution blocks 0110,1001 have h=D=0; the four residue classes give (h,D)=(0,0),(epsilon,-2k epsilon),(0,epsilon),(-epsilon,2(k+1)epsilon). The equation 2D(P_n)=n h(P_j)-j h(P_n) for fair cuts forces exactly all claimed minimal 1/2/3-piece lengths and unique 2-piece cut positions; n=1,2,3 checked separately. t_k frequency one half yields densities 1/4,3/8,3/8, and nonperiodicity follows by decimation from Thue–Morse. Independently computed the actual fair-D DP and unique pair cuts for all n<=80, but the argument—not the finite test—covers all n>=1.
residual_risks: Independent finite calculations corroborate only tested parameters; all-size reasoning relies on reviewed proof.
